about: Round world: each campsite's landing and way up (l: from the fire ring to the waterline) and latrine trail (t: from the ring to the box), keyed by the site's rounded x:z, as flat [dx, dz, ...] in decimetres from that point; b the bank's grade; m: the site moved to its flat (round flat: [dx, dz] decimetres from the key, ms its shore distance, m), so the ring and the rest are there.
